_doc: Function-level model fit for NVIDIA-as-tool bulk offload (WP-NVIDIA-FIT, 2026-07-26, owner directive: a Boss's bulk work must route by FUNCTION strength, not just its default NVIDIA role — 'an agent mag niet iets doen waar z'n model slecht in is'). Method: live single-shot mini-task probes on the real API key, output read and judged by hand (Claude) against the model-capability-matrix.json's existing honesty standard — no vibes, no model-card theory. `functions` maps each bulk-work function to the NVIDIA role/model judged good at it, with literal evidence and a fit verdict (correct | correct-but-slow | partial | none). `agentAllowedFunctions` lists which functions each nvidiaForBulkOnly Boss is currently wired to reach; claudeWinsSkipNvidia Bosses (boss/head-chef/review-boss/security-boss/integration-boss/ui-boss) deliberately have NO entry here — they never call NVIDIA regardless of function (agent-model-map.json usagePolicy, enforced in nvidia-provider.cjs BEFORE function resolution). HARD RULE (the owner's exact complaint, now enforced in code): a function with fit="none" or no model routes to NONE — Claude keeps that work; NVIDIA is never force-fit onto a function it's bad at. Re-probe alongside model-capability-matrix.json's ~1-week re-probe rule; function fit can drift if the underlying model drifts. UPDATED 2026-07-26 (WP-NVIDIA-CONSOLIDATE, owner follow-up: '1 model mag meerdere rollen doen — als 1 model meerdere functies beter kan dan de rest, dan houden we er 2 of 3 over'): 10 additional live cross-probes re-tested every weak spot from the first round (summarize's 57s minimax bottleneck, translate-rewrite's partial-fit mistral, code-draft's untested nano ceiling, research-digest's untried nemotron-3-super, data-extract's untried nemotron-3-super) against real same-task prompts. Result: nemotron-3-super and nemotron-3-nano now cover ALL 7 functions at fit="correct" — minimax-m3 and mistral-small-4-119b-2603 are no longer needed by ANY function (kept only as historical `alts` evidence, see `consolidation` below); deepseek-v4-flash lost its one function (research-digest) to a faster equally-correct nemotron-3-super result. See `consolidation` for the final verdict table. UPDATED 2026-09-24 (wp19 follow-up, run forge-2026-09-24-config-v250): nvidia/nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b now answers HTTP 410 Gone (end of life), so doc-draft, data-extract and summarize were re-pointed after a same-task cross-probe of 3 live candidates per function (one realistic prompt per function; mistral-nemotron at the default max_tokens, nemotron-3-super at 300, glm-5.3 at 400; one request per probe with retries refused, 25 s timeout, sequential; 11 probes, budget 12). PROBE TABLE 2026-09-24 (function / model: verdict, latency): summarize / mistral-nemotron: timeout >25s (twice) | summarize / nemotron-3-super @300: faithful but truncated (finish=length), 4332ms | summarize / nemotron-3-super @900: correct, 7159ms | summarize / glm-5.3: timeout >25s | data-extract / mistral-nemotron: values right but code-fenced (partial), 5342ms | data-extract / nemotron-3-super: correct, 2936ms | data-extract / glm-5.3: correct, 2112ms | doc-draft / mistral-nemotron: timeout >25s | doc-draft / nemotron-3-super: correct, 2803ms | doc-draft / glm-5.3: correct, 13490ms. NEW PICKS: doc-draft -> nemotron-3-super, data-extract -> glm-5.3, summarize -> nemotron-3-super (only candidate that answered; comparison incomplete). The dead model is listed under consolidation.droppedFromFunctionFit.

honesty: ROUND 1 (2026-07-26, WP-NVIDIA-FIT): 7 live single-shot probes, one per function (data-extract got 2, for a same-task cross-model latency comparison). ROUND 2 (2026-07-26, WP-NVIDIA-CONSOLIDATE, this update): 10 further live single-shot probes specifically re-testing every weak spot from round 1 for consolidation — 17 live probes total across both rounds. Every probe's real output was read and judged here by hand (correct / correct-but-slow / partial / none); no probe in either round came back outright wrong, so no function currently carries fit="none" in this file — but the routing mechanism for that case (resolveFunction() in nvidia-provider.cjs) is implemented and unit-tested with an injected fake fit-map so a genuinely bad-fit function is never force-routed once one is found. Every losing candidate's evidence is preserved inline (never deleted) per the owner's 'negative evidence is valuable' instruction. Re-probe alongside the matrix's ~1-week rule; a model recommended here can drift the same way roles do. ROUND 3 (2026-09-24, wp19 follow-up): 11 live single-shot probes re-pointed the 3 functions whose primary (nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b) had died with HTTP 410. Verdicts were judged by hand against each prompt's checkable answer (field values, sentence count, word limit, given facts). Honest limits: single probes on a busy endpoint (a sweep ran nemotron-3-super at concurrency 3 on the same key), 5 timeouts, and the summarize comparison is incomplete (only nemotron-3-super answered). mistral-nemotron — the matrix default/fast role model since 2026-09-24 — answered its 'OK' ping in 365ms but timed out on 3 of its 4 real-task probes here; that is recorded in model-capability-matrix.json as a risk, not fixed here.
